audit.whatIsWrong: Disk chart gave Riven levels 2, 3 and first item while the prose says 'out-trades her... own this overstep', 'win nearly any all-in', and 'neither lands a clean kill'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill/Kled/Kled/Skill/Skill/Skill/Riven) matches the prose exactly — including whys[3] 'Even' and whys[4] 'a coin-flip' — and fits 51.04%. Kled's only owned stages are 2 and 3; first item is genuinely even.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 flipped in both layers as one group; rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row said 'if she holds E shield and dashes she repositions out' without mentioning what Blade of the Exile actually adds.
audit.why: Her R grants bonus AD and attack RANGE plus one use of Wind Slash, a ranged attack — so at 6 she can punish from outside your engage rather than only escaping it. That is a different threat from mobility.
audit.corrected: whys[4] rewritten to the added range and the single Wind Slash.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (R Blade of the Exile, cd 120/90/60)

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Riven's abilities are named in the content layer, and no cooldowns appear anywhere. Everything is 'her Q dashes', 'her W stun', 'her E shield'.
audit.why: The single most useful fact in this lane is that all three casts of Broken Wings share ONE 13-second cooldown — so once the third dash is spent, her mobility is gone for a long, countable window. Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 and Valor 10s.
audit.corrected: whys[3], spikes[0].text, wants.foe[1], wants.foe[2] and dosFull[0].d rewritten with the real names and cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (Q Broken Wings cd 13, W Ki Burst cd 11/10/9/8/7, E Valor cd 10/9/8/7/6)

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line tells you to buy Executioner's Calling early because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Riven has no healing in her kit.
audit.why: Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Blade of the Exile contain no heal or lifesteal — Valor is a shield, which Grievous Wounds does not touch. This sends a player to spend 800 gold on a dead item in a lane decided by burst timing.
audit.corrected: report[8].t rewritten to drop the anti-heal buy.
sources: champ-data/_kits/riven.json (full kit — no heal flag on any ability)

edits.before: Even — she has all three Q dashes and E shield to sidestep or absorb your engage, so trade only when her dashes are down.
edits.after: Even — Broken Wings is one 13s cooldown for all three dashes and Valor's shield covers the gap, so trade only once both are spent.

edits.before: It's a coin-flip — your R knocks her out of her Q-stun combo, but if she holds E shield and dashes she repositions out and punishes the cooldown.
edits.after: A coin-flip — your R rams her out of the combo, but Blade of the Exile adds attack range and one Wind Slash, so she punishes from outside it.

edits.before: Your re-E (E in, W-shotgun, E back) plus a Bear Trap Q yank is your hardest all-in — punish her before her third Q dash and shield are reliably up.
edits.after: Your re-E (E in, W-shotgun, E back) plus a Bear Trap yank is your hardest all-in — Broken Wings is 13s, so strike the moment she spends it.

edits.before: Land her W stun to lock your re-E, then burst you inside her Q-Q-Q AOE window
edits.after: Land Ki Burst to lock your re-E, then burst you inside her Broken Wings

edits.before: Hold her E shield and dash to absorb your all-in, then out-trade once you've spent your combo
edits.after: Hold Valor's shield-dash to absorb your all-in, then out-trade once your combo is spent

edits.before: Her engage CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Anti-heal is dead gold — her kit has no healing.
